implementation.element_contract: Exactly one recognized *_damage tag on the credited kill fact; origin metadata is preserved independently. Missing or ambiguous classification emits chain_reaction_unresolved.
implementation.credit_policy: Owner and weapon must match an equipped perk source. Exclude threadling_damage. Derived kills otherwise retain weapon credit and may trigger further explosions. This is an explicit provisional content policy, not proof of every original-game interaction.
implementation.timing_policy: Snapshot attack at confirmed kill; center comes from receipt feet position. Positive delay detached; zero executes immediately. Stow retains eligibility; removal before kill prevents triggering, removal after snapshot does not cancel pending explosion.
implementation.falloff: Known plateau and zero edge; normalize interior by same-unit ratio and require external multiplier->multiplier profile. Synthetic linear test curve, no original-game linearity claim.
implementation.world_units: Synthetic 0.1 damage scale; distance uses meters as blocks.
implementation.unified_target_scaling: Dedicated outgoing stage, no weapon-archetype scaling. Complete current combatant rank values remain uncalibrated.
